bullets.bullet: The Federal Reserve Board released results from a survey of senior financial officers at banks on their strategies and practices for managing reserve balances.
ECB President Christine Lagarde published a piece titled "Acting in time"; the headline gives no further detail.
BEA data show worldwide employment by U.S. multinational enterprises rose 0.9% to 44.2 million workers in 2024 (preliminary) from 43.8 million in 2023 (revised).

headlines.title: Activities of U.S. Multinational Enterprises, 2024
headlines.summary: Worldwide employment by U.S. multinational enterprises increased 0.9 percent to 44.2 million workers in 2024 (preliminary) from 43.8 million workers in 2023 (revised), according to statistics released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis on the operations and finances of U.S. parent companies and their majority-owned foreign affiliates.
